title: Buffer Prospector: Discovering and Exploiting Untapped Buffer Resources in Many-Core DNN Accelerators
problem: Layer-pipeline (LP) mapping on many-core DNN accelerators exhibits significant underutilization of on-chip buffer space across cores due to timing mismatches between pipeline stages, wasting potential performance.
motivation: Many-core DNN accelerators with LP mapping are mainstream, but buffer underutilization represents a universal optimization opportunity overlooked by existing frameworks.
method: BufferProspector first calculates how much memory each core needs at each stage of the pipeline. Then it redistributes the unused memory sitting idle in some cores to the cores that need it more, timing everything so the memory is available when each stage runs. This solves the fundamental problem of buffer space going to waste because pipeline stages don't all need their memory at the same time.
key_novelty: BufferProspector recovers wasted buffer space by redistributing it among cores based on their actual timing requirements in layer-pipeline mapping, instead of letting it sit idle due to pipeline stage timing mismatches.
contributions: Identification of widespread buffer underutilization flaw in LP mapping
Buffer Requirement Calculator for per-core buffer analysis
Timing-aware Buffer Allocator for dynamic redistribution
1.44x energy efficiency improvement, 2.26x performance improvement vs SOTA (Tangram)
limitations: Not discussed; focus is on buffer optimization.
primary_theme: Buffer resource discovery and exploitation in many-core DNN accelerators
